Name: dizzi Portrait Style Switcher
Author: dizziRD
Description:
[heading]🎭 dizzi Portrait Style Switcher[/heading]
[b]A per-NPC portrait style selector for Content Patcher.[/b]
[quote]💡 [b]Recommended: install with an AI assistant or agent.[/b]
Give this page and the included install script to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or an agent with terminal access (Claude Code, Gemini CLI). Tell it where your Mods folder is and which styles you want, and let it guide you through both parts: [b]installing the source mods[/b] and [b]placing the portrait assets[/b] with the script. It can also diagnose anything that comes out missing.[/quote][line]
✨ What it does, and why it exists
If you install several portrait mods, only one of them wins each NPC, and the winner is decided by load order, not by you. Changing it means editing files by hand.
This pack adds a [b]per-NPC, per-style toggle[/b] on top of the portraits you already have installed. Every style is loaded from the mod that provides it. The switcher only decides which installed mod wins for each NPC, using Content Patcher’s own Priority and Conditions.
[b]🎨 11 styles plus Vanilla:[/b] Pretty, Beautiful, OO’s, Dacar, Lannah, Rasmodia, FadeHeim, Buxom, Skimpy Bachelor, Felicia and Kent Girl.
[b]🗺️ Coverage:[/b] the vanilla cast, Stardew Valley Expanded, East Scarp, and the random social NPCs (Dwarf, Gil, Gunther).
[b]Why the portrait authors don’t ship this themselves:[/b] a usable switcher has to reference the internal asset paths of every competing portrait mod, and the list has to be kept current as each of them updates. No single portrait author can reasonably maintain that.
[line]
📦 What is in this download
[list]
[*]⚙️ Content Patcher config files for the switcher and the force-load packs (
[code]content.json[/code],
[code]config.json[/code],
[code]manifest.json[/code])[/*]
[*]📄 Documentation (
[code]NPCS.md[/code],
[code]PLAN.md[/code])[/*]
[*]🛠️ Two install scripts, shipped as
[code].txt[/code]files and run with bash (see Installation)[/*]
[/list][b]It does not include the portrait artwork of the style authors.[/b] The install script copies it from the source mods you already have installed. The portraits belong to their respective authors and are not modified, recoloured or redistributed here.
If a style’s source mod isn’t installed, that style simply isn’t selectable. Nothing else is affected.
[line]
🚀 Installation
🤖 Option A: AI-assisted (recommended)
[list=1]
[*]Install the source mods for the styles you want (list below).[/*]
[*]Unzip the archive into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Hand the install script (
[code]install.bat.txt[/code]) to your AI assistant or agent, tell it your Mods path, and let it walk you through the asset copy or run it for you.[/*]
[*]Restart Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]🔧 Option B: Manual
[list=1]
[*][b]Install the source mods[/b] for the styles you want. Only the ones you actually use are needed.[/*]
[*][b]Unzip the archive into your Mods folder.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Run the install script.[/b] Open Git Bash (or WSL) inside the switcher folder and run:

[code]bash install.bat.txt[/code]
It copies the PNGs from your installed source mods into this pack’s
[code]assets/[/code]folders. It doesn’t use symlinks and doesn’t modify
[code]content.json[/code]or
[code]config.json[/code].[/*]
[*][b]Read the output.[/b] The
[code]TOTAL[/code]line should show all assets copied, and
[code]no source[/code]should be 0. If it isn’t, one of your source mods is missing or outdated.[/*]
[*][b]Restart Stardew Valley[/b] through SMAPI. Styles are chosen per NPC in the mod’s config menu.[/*]
[/list]🆘 If the script errors out, paste the terminal output (not the whole script) into the comments or into any AI assistant and ask what’s missing.
[line]
📋 Requirements
[list]
[*]Content Patcher 2.3.0 or newer[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Dialogue Display Framework Continued (DDFC) 0.7.5 or newer[/*]
[*]DDFC Scaler 2.0.0 or newer[/*]
[/list]🎁 Optional source mods (only for the styles you want)
[list]
[*]Pretty Anime Portraits / Pretty Anime Genderbends (SerDakota)[/*]
[*]Bountiful Beauties Vol. 1 and 2 (TheMud)[/*]
[*]OO’s Anime Style Skimpy Portraits, and its SVE edition (TwoCircles)[/*]
[*]Dacar’s portrait packs (DacarTheGorilla)[/*]
[*]Lannah - Female Lance (Nom0ri)[/*]
[*]FadeHeim’s Rasmodia and East Scarp anime style portrait (FadeHeim)[/*]
[*]kent girl (ZEROp1xe1)[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded (FlashShifter)[/*]
[*]East Scarp (LemurKat), needed for Aideen[/*]
[/list]🔞 [i]Optional adult content. Safe to skip if you don’t want it.[/i]
[line]
🙏 Credits
Every portrait style belongs to the author listed above. Please endorse their mods. The switcher logic and force-load packs are mine.
